overview.match: Gil Cisneros is the U.S. Representative for California’s 31s
overview.text: Gil Cisneros is the U.S. Representative for California’s 31st District, first elected to that seat in 2024. He previously served in the 116th Congress and as Under Secretary of Defense for Personnel and Readiness in the Biden administration. A Navy veteran, he sits on the House Armed Services Committee and the House Committee on Small Business. He also co-founded a foundation that provides college scholarships.

overview.text: He supports universal background checks. During his first term, he supported the Enhanced Background Checks Act, as well as bills to close the boyfriend loophole and fund community violence intervention. He also supported an assault weapons ban during his first term, which he has said he wants to reintroduce. He says he wants to reverse the “Big Ugly Bill” healthcare cuts, roll back Trump-era tariffs, and protect DACA recipients. He says he supports a permanent ceasefire and two-state solution in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. He voted against a government funding bill in November 2025, saying it failed to lower healthcare costs.
